Clouds-B render gate — Bruneton-stub validation

Instantiates CloudsEffect three times with different synthetic uSunColor / uAmbientColor / uHorizonColor / sun-direction uniforms (dawn, noon, dusk), forces shader compilation via renderer.compile(), and reports the readback. PASS if the modified Bruneton-stub shader compiles without errors and the new uniforms are present on the material.
